logic_group.name: nDPI DGA detection
logic_group.description: The DGA (Domain Generation Algorithm) detection module in nDPI identifies algorithmically generated domain names typically used by malware. It implements a heuristic-based analysis that evaluates domain components using bigram and trigram frequency distributions (comparing against common English patterns), 'impossible' bigram detection, and various statistical measures including vowel-to-consonant ratios, digit density, and character repetition patterns.
